primary_question.question: Why does my Rava Idli taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not stop stirring or the rava may scorch

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Rava Idli?
evidence: Stand back when curry leaf hits hot ghee because it may splutter

related_questions.question: Why does my Rava Idli curdle or split?
evidence: Do not add curd while the mixture is hot or it may split

related_questions.question: Why is my Rava Idli batter not right?
evidence: Do not make the batter runny; rava idli batter should be thick

related_questions.question: Why is my Rava Idli too dense or dry?
evidence: Do not leave lumps of dry rava at the bottom
